test: does a re-derived (numerically-close) imatrix reproduce the published Q4_K_M?
conclusion: The imatrix does not re-derive bit-for-bit (0/186), and a 5.5e-5 relative difference propagates to ~141/335 quantized tensors, so bit-exact reproduction of Q requires the EXACT published imatrix (bound by hash), not a recomputed one. Imatrix generation is a third FP-environment-dependent hop in the verification chain.
